request.state:
Vela Transit awards the “on-time” status when arrival is no later than 18:00 at the destination clock. Dispatch predicted 17:52. A monitoring banner at 17:55 read “ON TIME,” but banners are forecasts and freeze once a trip enters the tunnel. The actual gate scan, which is the authoritative arrival record, occurred at 18:04. A passenger message says the bus reached the station “around six,” and the driver’s handwritten log says 17:59; policy resolves discrepancies in favor of the gate scan unless it is flagged faulty. No fault flag exists.

Policy excerpt: Timing standard T4 uses the first unflagged physical gate scan. Manual estimates, scans marked TEST, and dispatch-board projections do not substitute; equality with the deadline is on time.

criteria.indeterminate: No authoritative actual time can be selected.
criteria.on_time: Authoritative actual arrival is at or before 18:00.
